rites.name: Miinora
rites.text: Miinora is the concept of the Singing in Ryanirae, the sounding through which the first roots of the world condensed during the Holy Age, when temples rose and orders bound their flame to the land. It is remembered not as a deed but as a resonance that the orders still try to hear again in their chants.

rites.name: Karaithun
rites.text: Karaithun is a council-summoned rite in the Courts of Ryanirae, in which the sovereign's envoys bind a drifting grove-spirit to the first door between worlds. The binding wrenches the surrounding groves into a single pulse that is felt across three kingdoms and recorded in the trial-ledgers of the age.

rites.name: Syisyuthith
rites.text: Syisyuthith is the concept of threshold-keeping in Ryanirae, the principle by which the Courts hold each door between worlds shut until the appointed hour. It was named in the first council, when the builders agreed that every passage needed a rule as well as a frame.

rites.name: Xaazyusasha
rites.text: Xaazyusasha is the concept of the Weave's planting in Ryanirae, the moment the makers sow threads of quiet power into the soil of the Arcane Realm before any of it wakes. It is less a being than a pattern of what dormant powers will someday become. Its feats describe the planting and the slow stirring that follows.

rites.name: Gruktogak
rites.text: Gruktogak is the concept of the Sundering in Ryanirae's Arcane Realm, the force that split worlds apart and turned old bonds to dust. Its wardens taught that every shard keeps a memory of the Pact that once held it whole.

rites.name: Sesyuthith
rites.text: Sesyuthith is a concept of the Arcane Realm of Ryanirae, understood in the Walled Age as the binding principle that holds ward-walls and orders together through centuries of duty and rite. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between peoples, it became the thread that first crossings tried to carry across the broken divides.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is the concept of the Walls that held back the sea and the old dread of it, binding the orders that kept the first crossings alive. In the Age of Sundering it became the name for the moment landfall broke old bonds and let the walls fail. Its strength was measured by how long a city could hold.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a tidewoven spirit of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 era, who breathes slow currents of luminous mist across the shattered coasts of Ryanirae. It is said to be able to unmake the weight of stone and sea alike, though it rarely does so except to prevent ruin.

rites.name: Lyanneth
rites.text: Lyanneth is a concept in the Ryanirae omniverse, an arcane discipline that folds the flow of time inside a caster's working. Its practitioners compress the moments of a minor incantation until the spell lands with a force far beyond its slot, rarely without cost to the surrounding hours.

rites.name: Mienae
rites.text: Mienae is a quiet archivist-sorcerer of the Arcane realm's sixth era, known for coaxing the hours inside a sealed vessel to slow to a crawl. Her hand-written ledgers record every stolen moment she has returned to the living world.

rites.name: Alaannileth
rites.text: Alaannileth is a dormant principle of foresight that the mages of Ryanirae call the Unwritten Tide, a current of possible outcomes that only the most disciplined can grasp. Those who wield it can draw one unrealized future into the present and let its consequences ripple outward through the surrounding events.

rites.name: Lyera
rites.text: Lyera is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryanirae omniverse, a veil of drifting mirror-motes that can carry a mind out of its body and into a reflected double. Its power lets a thinker wander through the duplicate's eyes for a short while, leaving the original form quiet and open to harm.

rites.name: Ryerualiel
rites.text: Ryerualiel is a dormant gravitic concept woven into the arcane discipline of the E6 era, a pattern of pull that the old scholars sketched but never fully wrote down. Its youngest form, only three ages old, hums quietly beneath the surface of the Arcane realm, waiting for a practitioner bold enough to name it.

rites.name: Nuilaena
rites.text: Nuilaena is a quiet discipline of bending weight within the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, practiced by scholars who measure a chamber's pull before daring to alter it. Its adepts claim that the third age of the E6 cycle saw its first sanctioned lattices, each one hummed into the air like a hymn of falling stones.

rites.name: Elirlae
rites.text: Elirlae is a concept of resonant memory that binds a lone flicker of thought to the fabric of the Arcane realm, letting it sing back in the Ryanirae epoch of the third age. Those who learn it can split their present self into fleeting duplicates that carry the same will but are born from echoes of what has already been.

rites.name: Elarineth
rites.text: Elarineth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryanirae, an unbound resonance that lets a bearer split a second self from their own outline and set it adrift in the air. The echo mirrors every motion of its source, and the bearer can swap places with it in a blink. Some cartographers of the era claim the echo can also bend light.

rites.name: Elaenys
rites.text: Elaenys is a tide-binding seer from the Ryanirae Arcane realm, a concept of living currents of time that she shapes at the edge of her sight. Three centuries into the E6 era she remains a young and unpredictable force, able to stall a foe's momentum mid-stride or fold a single moment into a shard of silver light.

rites.name: Nuerlaelora
rites.text: Nuerlaelora is a sigil-woven resonance that binds drifting mana into a single lattice of pale light, used by the Ryanirae archivists to store and redirect arcane pressure. Its wardens treat it as a living reservoir, tuned across three eras to hold the weight of collapsing spells.

rites.name: Venuarleth
rites.text: Venuarleth is a binding-principle of the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, a sealed contract that lets a spirit of resonance step between the striker and the struck. In the Sixth Era, mages of the Ashen Concord invoked it to take blows meant for their allies, though its recorded uses are few and dangerous.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a quiet, rule-bound principle of the Arcane realm in the Ryanirae omniverse, describing how a mind's sharpness tilts the order of moments when a crisis begins. Scholars of the sixth era treat it as a tuning of attention rather than a force, though its bearers can nudge the first movement of a conflict. It is measured only in small, personal stakes.

rites.name: Siluanaemae
rites.text: Siluanaemae is a dormant resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Ryanirae during its sixth era, a shadow-song that answers only to those who have bled for their oaths. It surges through a bearer's echo when they strike, sharpening every blow into a rolling thunder of memory. Legends claim a single awakened strike once cracked a moon's frozen crust.

rites.name: Lyarwen
rites.text: Lyarwen is a gravity-bending concept from the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, drawn from the sixth era and only three ages old. It channels crushing weight through shared allies, letting a single strike carry the density of a falling moon. Its accompanying craft is said to fold the pull of distant stars into the moment of impact.

rites.name: Orierlae
rites.text: Orierlae is a quiet glass-kiln city in the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, where artisans fuse sand with hours that were never spent. Its sealed vaults hold a single cracked hourglass that once slowed a dying sun by a fraction of a breath. Visitors are warned that no one there counts time without paying for it.

rites.name: Elarlys
rites.text: Elarlys is a discipline of the Ryanirae Arcane realm, practiced in the E6 era by scholars who study the pull and push that hold distant bodies in their places. Its adepts are said to tune the tides of their own sigils to bend the currents that bind stone to stone and star to star. Only a few concentrated heavens of the era have ever been bent by its hand.

rites.name: Oriamaenna
rites.text: Oriamaenna is a whispered-about veil of silver sigils that a Ryanirae concept-mind weaves around its bearer, letting them slip unseen through any crowded settlement of ten thousand souls or more. Its age is only two, yet it already threads a quiet doorway between the arcane realm and the mortal streets. Those who wear it say it hums most strongly when a hidden refuge is near.

rites.name: Silaerwen
rites.text: Silaerwen is a dormant arcane concept in the Ryanirae cosmos, a lattice of quiet resonance-threads woven through the Arcane realm during the sixth era. Born only three ages ago, it is less a being than an idea that schools of mages half-remember and never quite agree upon.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a silver-threaded concept of the Arcane realm in the fourth age of the E6 era, a tide of bottled moonlight that recasts a fleeting spark into a reversal of its own harm. Its tale is told in the tallow-scented ledgers of wayside alchemists, who record how a single swallowed draught can turn a feeble ember into a mirrored echo. The concept asks only that the first strike of a minor spell be answered by a surge far greater than the caster ever intended.

rites.name: Lyaleth
rites.text: Lyaleth is a silver-tinged tonic brewed in the drowned libraries of Ryanirae, said to grant its drinker a pair of sleeping sparks that wake only when fate tilts. In the Arcane age of the Sixth Era it is prized as a last resort, since the sparks can bend a single doomed moment toward survival.

rites.name: Elaenae
rites.text: Elaenae is a veil of woven moonlight that drifts over the weary, rendering them briefly unseen to pursuers. Its wearer can stitch the veil into a single lantern of pale fire, which the old scholars of its realm believe can bend the flow of a river. The veil itself is fragile and tears easily when worn for too long.

rites.name: Nuaraelae
rites.text: Nuaraelae is a concept of hushed arcane craft in the Ryanirae omniverse, an idea of a bound resonance that gathers quiet sparks into sharp, deliberate bursts. Its makers in the third age of the sixth era treated it as a teaching instrument rather than a weapon, measuring every release against careful limits.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a quiet lattice of frozen sunlight in the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, kept young by a crystalline rind that drinks away the slow decay of time. Scholars of the sixth era say no clock has ever ticked against it, and no spell that works by withering has taken hold of its form.

rites.name: Elaemys
rites.text: Elaemys is a quiet lantern-spirit of the Ryanirae arcane realm, born in the third age to guide travelers through fog-choked marshes. Its gift is a flicker of bright sparks that can lull a crowd into slumber, and it tends its glow with unusual patience.

rites.name: Miimerlae
rites.text: Miimerlae is a seasonal pattern of thorned weather that the Arcane powers of the E6 era gather into a single tuned chord of rain and root. It is young, only three years into its existence, and its strongest act is to hold a glacier's worth of stone in a green grip that can knot a whole valley shut.

rites.name: Venalys
rites.text: Venalys is an arcane concept in the Ryanirae omniverse, a sealed ward-word that a dying mind can speak to pull a single spark of breath back across the threshold of ending. Its power is small and stubborn, a flicker rather than a flood, yet scholars of the sixth era regard it as proof that even the last moment holds a door.

rites.name: Miarileth
rites.text: Miarileth is a concept of persuasive resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Ryanirae during its sixth era. It is said to bend the wills of listeners toward a chosen conclusion, though its reach has never been tested against a gathering larger than a council.

rites.name: Oriimae
rites.text: Oriimae is a silent lattice of mirrored sigils that drifts through the Arcane realm of Ryanirae, reading the intent behind every spoken lie. Scholars of the sixth era consulted it to unravel buried conspiracies, though its gaze can shatter the minds of those who attempt to hide from it.

rites.name: Alaalora
rites.text: Alaalora is a veil-craft that lets a living being keep its own body and nature while register as hollow-dead to any enchantment that reads for the undying. The veil is woven from borrowed grave-silence and lasts only as long as the wearer keeps a vow of stillness.

rites.name: Miamys
rites.text: Miamys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryanirae omniverse, an art of silent passage whose practitioners leave no trail that clever hunters can follow. Its adepts move freely through tangled undergrowth and wild thicket, and the wood seems to part for them as though it recognized a friend. Those who master the discipline are said to vanish from pursuit as easily as breath leaves a cold window.

rites.name: Lyala
rites.text: Lyala is a whispering sigil-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Ryanirae during its sixth era, a presence that clings to minds rather than bodies. Those it touches find their resolve briefly frayed, leaving them stumbling against the next test of will they face.

rites.name: Ryeniorlae
rites.text: Ryeniorlae is an arcane principle in the Ryanirae omniverse that binds a wielder's pain to a reflex of retaliation, turning each wound into a spark of counterstrike. Its strongest manifestations, drawn from the sixth era's ambient magic, can unmake whole fortresses in a single answering blow.

rites.name: Orieluarlys
rites.text: Orieluarlys is a hushed art of stored fortune, in which a caster can seed a willing soul with a reservoir of coiled chance. The reservoir is spent in a single decisive moment, bending a failing roll or a falling blade toward triumph.

rites.name: Alaeneilora
rites.text: Alaeneilora is a gentle sparkle of silver thread that a caster weaves through a willing ally's sleeve, granting a quickened pulse of readiness for a short while. It is a minor binding of attention and reflex, used in the wind-swept courts of the Ryanirae to help allies seize the first moment of any contest.

rites.name: Miillora
rites.text: Miillora is a cognitive discipline practised in the Arcane realm of Ryanirae during its sixth era, in which a practitioner fractures the boundaries that separate neighboring worlds and moments, flooding a single mind with conflicting histories until it unravels. Its wielders are sought after as both healers of shattered minds and feared as instruments of psychic war.

rites.name: Eluarlemae
rites.text: Eluarlemae is a sorcerous art of the Arcane realm, practiced in the sixth age of Ryanirae, that drains the living warmth from a single visible creature and folds it into the caster's own marrow. Its practitioners are young, having studied the craft for only three ages, and they treat its power with wary reverence.

rites.name: Veneinerys
rites.text: Veneinerys is a sealed resonance of the Arcane realm, born three ages ago when a choir of ancient glyphs fell silent in the Ryanirae deeps. It can pull a single wary mind out of its place and cast it across a quiet gulf of thought, leaving only a faint echo where it stood.

rites.name: Elaemys
rites.text: Elaemys is a silver-threaded hymn of the Arcane realm, sung in the sixth era by hollow choirs that bind two watching souls into a shared tremor. Its hymn drains the hearts of those who listen too closely, a cost the singers accept as reverent. Three centuries old, it is still taught in the hollow halls of Ryanirae.

rites.name: Ilyarla
rites.text: Ilyarla is a sealed rhythm of the Arcane realm, a pattern of pulsing silence that the Ryanirae archivists cataloged as an instrument rather than a being. Its wielders strike it to unravel the living timeline of a single body they can see, compressing decades into an instant of decay. The rhythm has no appetite and forgets its owner's name each time it is used.

rites.name: Nuerae
rites.text: Nuerae is a concept of Ryanirae that the Library of the Three Futures files among its shelved branching endings. During the Holy Age, it is taken up by temple orders as a flame that burns the sealed paths of any outcome it touches.
